parsed.rationale: Although the two types share structural shape (both are `type-alias-object` with `shared_field_count: 1` and no fields listed), they carry distinct names — `TextHeightPreferenceKey` in `app:WatchXYC` (`WatchXYC/PlayerPage.swift:140`) and `ScrollOffsetPreferenceKey` in `app:iOS` (`iOS/Views/Playlist/Playcut Detail/PlaycutRowView.swift:74`) — encoding unrelated UI measurement concerns (text height vs. scroll offset) in separate platform targets (watchOS vs. iOS). The structural coincidence is a consequence of both conforming to the same SwiftUI `PreferenceKey` boilerplate pattern, not shared domain logic. Merging or extracting them would conflate semantically distinct preference keys and couple two independent platform targets unnecessarily.
